# Sprezzature

> Nine Claude / OpenCode skills for one frontend stack: UI, CLI-to-GUI, publishing, accessibility, colors, alt text, captions, Laws of UX, and data-science figures. Each skill both makes artifacts and audits them.

## Home

- [Sprezzature — nine Claude / OpenCode skills for vanilla JS + Tailwind](https://sprezzature.ai/): Sprezzature is nine Claude / OpenCode skills for a single frontend stack: UI, CLI-to-GUI, publishing, accessibility, colors, alt text, captions, Laws of UX, and data-science figures. Each skill both makes artifacts and audits them.

## Skills

- [UI generation — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/ui.html): Vanilla JavaScript + Tailwind UI — components, pages, forms, dialogs, dashboards — for solo devs shipping internal tools without a designer.
- [CLI → GUI — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/cli.html): Wrap an existing command-line tool in a single-page vanilla-JS + Tailwind GUI — read the arg parser, emit forms, file inputs and a streaming log panel.
- [Publishing — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/publish.html): Turn a folder of Markdown into a static site: per-page meta tags, a full favicon / PWA-icon set from one logo, robots + sitemap + llms.txt + feeds, plain-language rewrites, and loc
- [Accessibility — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/accessibility.html): Pre-commit static HTML accessibility lint for vanilla-JS + Tailwind output — fourteen rules decidable from source, no browser, no runtime DOM.
- [Colors — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/colors.html): Color tooling, make and audit — WCAG contrast with OKLCH-neighbour fixes, colour-vision-deficiency simulation, a curated palette, and a Tailwind config emitter. Dete
- [Vision — alt text — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/vision.html): W3C-compliant alt-text drafting via a local Ollama vision model — a per-image decision tree, output in any detected language, deterministic on-disk cache. The one model is qwen3-vl:8b.
- [Audio — captions — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/audio.html): Local-AI captions, speaker diarization and speaker identification for video / audio. WebVTT / SRT from a local whisper.cpp, who-spoke-when via NeMo, who-is-who via embeddings or a
- [Laws of UX — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/ux-laws.html): Apply the canonical Laws of UX (Jon Yablonski) to vanilla-JS + Tailwind — both when making new UI and when auditing existing HTML. Reference covers 30 laws with trigger / action /
- [Figures — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/figures.html): A rendered catalog of charts and statistical plots from sprezzature-figures: 124 hand-authored SVG chart types, all from fake data on a curated palette.

## Case studies

- [Case studies — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/case-studies.html): Three advanced examples with the Ralph Eyeball Loop: a tribute to Hans Rosling's animation, publication-grade situation maps, and a systematic markets dashboard, all interactive.
- [Tribute to Hans Rosling — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/hans-rosling.html): An animated, interactive tribute to Hans Rosling's health-and-wealth bubble chart — every country, one frame per year 1950 to 2025, in a single self-contained SVG with no JavaScript library. Real data, historical splits and merges.
- [Maps — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/maps.html): Publication-grade cartography: an Equal Earth choropleth with an OKLCH ramp, layered Lambert Conformal Conic situation maps with real relief, plus glyph/cartogram thematic maps and real French election data.
- [Financial markets — Favourable case — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/financial-markets.html): A systematic portfolio with automatic size Kₜ, told in ten interactive SVG panels, colour-blind-safe, in market-finance colours. Favourable and adverse draws. This favourable case shows +123% net return.
- [Financial markets — Adverse case — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/financial-markets-adverse.html): A systematic portfolio with automatic size Kₜ, told in ten interactive SVG panels, colour-blind-safe, in market-finance colours. Favourable and adverse draws. This adverse case shows -26% net return.

## Reference

- [Packages — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/packages.html): The deterministic tools behind the sprezzature skills, each a standalone pip-installable package with its own repository: figures, colors, accessibility, CLI-to-GUI, Laws of UX, audio, the local runtime, and the engine picker.
- [The Ralph Eyeball Loop — Sprezzature](https://sprezzature.ai/ralph-eyeball-loop.html): You can't proofread a chart by reading its code. The Ralph Eyeball Loop renders the thing, looks at it, and fixes what the eye catches, then does it again. How Sprezzature makes figures, diagrams and pages that hold up.

## French (Français)

Every page above has a French translation at the same path under `/fr/` (e.g. `/fr/figures.html`), declared via `hreflang` on each page.
